title: Status board
summary: A claude.ai status board per repository, rendered from the checklist and progress files at fixed moments.
why: A board you can open on a phone shows every repository's plan and progress at the cost of two tool calls per push.

items.title: Status board renderer
items.does: Copies kit_board.py, which renders the board deterministically from the checklist and progress files and prints the two tool calls that publish it; the board link is yours, entered in the wizard.
items.why: Rendering from files rather than from the model keeps each push cheap and the board identical to the real state.

items.title: Board pushed only at fixed moments
items.does: Adds the rule that the board is pushed at session start, after each checklist reprint and at /done, and the /done step for the final push.
items.why: A bounded number of pushes keeps the board's cost predictable.
